topics.title: Move hot renderer paths from JavaScript into Rust

entries.title: Move hot renderer paths from JavaScript into Rust
entries.rationale: Accept the renderer-performance objectives, but queue a Zion-owned incremental migration. The commit changes 42 paths, introduces a one-way localStorage-to-SQLite transition, and affects relay lifecycle, archive sync, unread state, and persona verification. It must preserve Zion community isolation and current storage compatibility.
security_reasons: storage and relay lifecycle changes can leak state across community boundaries if scope resets are incomplete
native migration and epoch handling require failure and rollback validation

tracking.implementation_plan: Review each renderer path separately; implement migration guards, relay-bound state resets, rollback-safe persistence, and performance baselines before any inclusion.

verification: Full SHA, 42 changed paths, storage transition, lifecycle risk, and test claims reviewed; no source implementation made.
